name: Update Inventory
description: Update an inventory item. At least one attribute or relationship must be provided.

pathParams.name: Id
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the inventory item to update

requestBody.description: Update inventory object. At least one attribute must be provided.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Reorder
attributes.description: The reorder threshold for the inventory item.

attributes.name: Cost
attributes.description: The cost of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A description of the inventory item.

attributes.name: PartNumber
attributes.description: The part number of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Shelf
attributes.description: The bin/shelf location of the inventory item.

attributes.name: Category
attributes.description: The category of the inventory item.

attributes.name: LocationId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the inventory location.

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the GL account (must be expense type).

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated inventory item
